parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The name or IP address of the Cobbler system. Default: "127.0.0.1"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password to log in to Cobbler.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port number to be used for REST connection. The default value depends on parameter use_ssl.

parameters.name: use_ssl
parameters.description: If false, an HTTP connection is used instead of the default HTTPS connection. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username to log in to Cobbler. Default: "cobbler"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false when used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Commit Cobbler changes
  community.general.cobbler_sync:
    host: cobbler01
    username: cobbler
    password: MySuperSecureP4sswOrd
  run_once: true
  delegate_to: localhost
